meta.title: Order Activity records a vendor revising a bid
gaps: Verify the new activity line names the vendor who revised the bid and includes the correct date and time.
Verify all earlier activity entries remain present and that the entries are in chronological order.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify the new activity line names the vendor who revised the bid and includes the correct date and time.; Verify all earlier activity entries remain present and that the entries are in chronological order.

steps.note: Start a new buyer-side eRFX event for the bid revision flow.
Provide the required event title so the event can be published.
Configure the event with an RFQ pricing stage.
Work on the RFQ stage before configuring its template and sheet.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add one line item for the vendor quote.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet before publishing.
Invite one QA vendor who will submit and revise the bid.
Publish the event so the vendor can bid.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Have the first QA vendor submit the initial bid.
Confirm the initial vendor bid was accepted.
Have the same vendor revise its bid, which is the event action under test.
Confirm the revised bid was accepted.
Open the RFQ stage's Order Activity drawer.
Confirm the Order Activity drawer is open and its activity content is visible.
Check for activity text indicating the bid revision, to the extent the rendered wording exposes it.
